comparison.treatment: n/a (both arms failed identically before training could start)

root_cause: The fresh session container's Python 3.12 venv was created via `pip install -e .` (base dependency set only); the repo declares `torch` as an optional extra (`pyproject.toml` `[project.optional-dependencies].torch` and `.dev`), so `scripts/train_model.py` failed at `detect_device` before any training step ran. Not a harness code defect and not a model result.
fix: Reinstalled the environment with `pip install -e ".[dev,torch]"` (torch 2.5.1+cu124 CPU-capable wheel resolved). No repository code changed; this is an ephemeral-container environment-bootstrap gap, matching the pattern documented in prior sessions' AgentV NODE_OPTIONS / torch-missing infra cycles (e.g. PR #1264, PR #1292).
